payload.name: Applications
payload.description: Features and functionality related to Fuuz Apps in the platform.

payload.name: Customer Relationship Management
payload.description: Functionality around managing customer relationships, such as sales.

payload.name: Human Capital Management
payload.description: Functionality around managing human capital, such as employees, departments, and positions.

payload.name: Inventory Management
payload.description:
- **Real-time Inventory Tracking**: Monitors stock levels and item locations.
- **Cycle Counting**: Regular inventory checks to ensure accuracy.
- **Lot and Serial Number Tracking**: Manages batches and individual items.

payload.name: Materials Management
payload.description: Functionality around managing handling of physical materials, such as inventory and logistics.

payload.name: Order Fulfillment
payload.description:
- **Order Processing**: Manages picking, packing, and shipping.
- **Wave Picking**: Groups orders for efficient picking.
- **Packing and Shipping**: Ensures orders are packed correctly and shipped promptly.

payload.name: Product Data Management
payload.description: Functionality around managing product data, such as engineering, quality, and materials.

payload.name: Production Management
payload.description: Functionality around managing production, such as planning and manufacturing.

payload.name: Receiving
payload.description:
- **Order Receiving**: Processes incoming shipments.
- **Quality Control**: Inspects goods upon arrival.
- **Putaway Management**: Directs items to their storage locations.

payload.name: Site Management
payload.description: ISA-95 standards recommend a Site -> Area -> Line -> Cell -> Workcenter hierarchy. This module group manages the Site, Area, and Line aspects.

payload.name: Supply Chain Management
payload.description: Functionality around managing supply chains, such as procurement.

payload.name: System
payload.description: Funcitonality that affects behavior system-wide, such as access control, integration, and business intelligence.
